Seven of a Kind — No Loki’s Helm36 + Automatic Win of the Round
Seven Loki’s HelmsAutomatic Loss of the Round

Seven matching Runes with no Loki’s Helm showing score 36 points and automatically win the round. Seven Runes all showing Loki’s Helm automatically lose the round.

Fate Bone Scoring Effects

Raven — Steal Glory: Opponent loses 5 points for the current round, minimum 0.

Stag — Claim Honor: Player adds 10 points to the current round.

Final Bone Judgment

Wolf → Raven → Serpent → Bear → Stag

The higher-ranked Fate Bone wins. The winner doubles their Round 1 score and adds that doubled amount to their accumulated score.

If both players reveal the same Fate Bone, neither player receives the Bone Judgment bonus. No additional Fate Bones are played. Existing scores are totaled as they stand.

NO CHAMPION HOLDS FORTUNE FOREVER.
